description: List the services offered by Context Studios. Every service sits under one of six goals (cluster) and is delivered in one or more of four formats (workshop, setup, sprint, build); only the workshop format has public prices, everything else is quoted after scoping.

serviceId.description: Exact service identifier returned by get_services, for example mvp-sprint or ai-agents.

name: get_services

count.description: Number of returned records for list and search tools.

data.description: Structured result payload. Present for responseFormat='v2' tools.

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

meta.description: Result metadata such as count, locale fallback, cache scope, or response format.

success.description: Whether the tool call completed successfully.

title: Get Services
